summary: You need the five CHPR foundation courses, 9 units of Biostatistics and Research Methods courses (EPI 258 or EPI 259, and CHPR 247 or PEDS 202C, but not both of a pair), two quarters of the CHPR 290 internship (6 units) and two quarters of CHPR 399 thesis (4 units). Pre-approved electives, extra Biostatistics units and approved petitions make up the rest of the 45 graduate units, at least 30 of them in CHPR courses. Every course must be letter graded when a letter grade is offered. The Contemplation by Design subplan is optional: if you pick it, you need CHPR 234, 241, 244 and 2 units of CHPR 233, with its electives, for 12 units that also count toward the degree. You check by hand the 3.0 GPA, the 3 quantitative research-methods units the CHPR Office approves, petitioned electives, the master's thesis, and in the subplan that 9 of its units are CHPR courses.

program.why: Grading: "All courses must be taken for a letter grade if that is offered." The Bulletin's own 45-unit minimum is now in the data.

totals.label: 30 units of CHPR courses
totals.why: Other requirements: "30 of 45 Units must be from CHPR subject code courses." "CHPR units can come from any course with a CHPR subject code (e.g., CHPR 232). Approved electives with other subject codes (e.g., EPI 259) do not count towards the 30 unit CHPR minimum"

88RaeGRE.why: "The optional subplan in Contemplation by Design ... Completion of the subplan results in a notation that appears on the transcript and diploma. Students declare the subplan by submitting eform 'Field of Study (Subplan) Declaration or Change for Graduate Students'": a subplan a student may pick or leave (subplanRequired false), with "12 units of coursework that count towards the 45 unit minimum", so its courses also count elsewhere (shares).

oVtyqq1x.why: "students must complete a minimum of 45 units" is the Bulletin's unitsMin, "All courses must be taken for a letter grade if that is offered" is program.letterGrade, and "30 of 45 units must be from CHPR subject code courses" is a program total. The rest is an overview.

Z1dcNtSr.why: "Students may take any combination of the courses listed here, except for the following: students may take either EPI 258 or EPI 259 but not both, and students may take either CHPR 247 or PEDS 202C but not both."

1owmSWrw.why: "Students may count the courses below to count towards the 45-unit residency total." The list offers courses toward the 45 units and asks for none of its own (extra Biostatistics units and petitioned courses also count), so it is optional and the 45-unit minimum does the checking.

5NkCbSN5.why: Notes: "Take for at least two quarters; six total units." Two enrollments, six units in all.

NBImbIvx.why: Notes: "Take for at least two quarters; four total units." Two enrollments, four units in all.

toq96FNY.why: How to petition for an elective that is not pre-approved (course number of 100 or greater, at least 3 units, letter grade, CHPR Office approval); an approved course is moved into the electives by hand. Its sentence "Students are required to take a minimum of 30 CHPR units" is the program total of 30 CHPR units.

MkrLikZ9.why: "Students must complete a consecutive two-quarter-long community-based research internship under the supervision of a mentor approved by the CHPR Office. Students will receive six total units for their internships." The same CHPR 290 units are required by "Curricular Practical Training and Research Internship" (5NkCbSN5) in the program requirements; this restates them.

a1iI99QP.why: "Students are required to complete a master's thesis."

kCEjDIlM.why: "The optional subplan in Contemplation by Design ... requires 12 units of coursework that count towards the 45 unit minimum for the CHPR MS, 9 of which must have a CHPR course code." The 12 units are the block floor, the 9 CHPR units are rule ov-cbd-chpr, and the subplan's courses also count toward the rest of the degree (block shares).

S87gFWBr.why: "Complete any combination of the approved elective courses below to reach the minimum 12 unit requirement for the subplan." The required courses can reach 12 units on their own, so electives only top up the block's 12-unit floor.

HCyWsybh.why: The Bulletin's rule has no name; its note says "CHPR 233: 2 units are required, and if taken for 3 units, 1 unit will count as an elective unit."
